name: silvershop-suite/card-cache
description: Materialised (pre-rendered) product-card HTML stored in a dedicated table, so a product listing concatenates warm card markup instead of rendering + querying every tile per request.

suggest.silvershop-suite/storefront: Provides the ProductCard atom + PLP whose grid this cache accelerates.
suggest.silvershop/stock: For a truly query-free listing: needs the per-page stock prefetch (6.1.0+, currently on the perf/reduce-stock-queries branch). card-cache is correct on any/no stock, but earlier stock re-introduces a per-tile stock query in the fingerprint.
suggest.symbiote/silverstripe-queuedjobs: Run the full card-warm as a background job instead of inline.
